evidence: The central point this quarter is that I will place somewhat greater emphasis on the credit quality of our portfolio.
This is a topic of interest given tighter macroeconomic conditions, interest rates, and the economy as a whole.
I will start with our traditional overview covering key indicators such as results, profitability, loan portfolio, non-interest expenses, and delinquency.
Beginning with results, we delivered a very strong managerial result of BRL 12.3 billion in the first quarter, representing a 10% increase year-over-year.
Moving on to profitability, we recorded ROE of 24.8% on a consolidated basis and 26.4% in Brazil.
We saw an expansion in profitability adjusted for 11.5% capital, which is the current industry average and the lower bound of our capital appetite.
Consolidated ROE reached 25.8% and ROE in Brazil reached 27.6%.
This is fully aligned with the work we have been carrying out under our efficiency program and the targets that were set.

key_takeaways: Profitability and ROE sustainability were central themes in the call.
Credit quality and delinquency trends were a key risk-monitoring focus.
Efficiency initiatives were highlighted as a driver of profitability.
Management addressed its full-year guidance and its comfort with it.
Capital position and capital generation were discussed.
guidance: If you want a reference, we continue to aim for the midpoint of our guidance, which implies annual expense growth of 3.5%.
As mentioned, as Milton mentioned, we are very comfortable with the guidance that we have.
In the guidance that we gave at the beginning of the year, there is a profitability above 20%, and we are delivering this ROE recurrently.
Speaking of the guidance, the best answer that I can give you, we are comfortable with the guidance that is there.
There is a guidance of portfolio that we are still comfortable with what was published.

analyst_questions.question: Good morning, Milton, Gabriel, Gustavo. Congratulations on the predictability of your results. Very constant, very predictable. I wanted to hear your initial impressions on the Desenrola program and on Rede. What are the next steps for Rede, especially regarding payouts and strategic positioning?
analyst_questions.response_summary: Let me start by Desenrola, the program. Desenrola is building.

analyst_questions.question: I wanted to understand the trajectory of the bank's ROE. Itaú delivered a recurrent ROE of around 25%, even in a seasonally weaker quarter. How many levers remain available to maintain or expand this ROE throughout the year? Will sustainability come from client margin, efficiency, credit mix, service revenues, or ca...
analyst_questions.response_summary: Well, the issue of the ROE, as we always mention, and I'm gonna answer your question, but I'm gonna do it with a disclaimer. We avoid giving guidance of ROE because there is a lot of variables at the end of the day that affect accountability.

analyst_questions.question: Delinquency has been intensifying according to macroeconomic data, although Itaú continues to perform better than the market. Considering current macroeconomic conditions, credit quality, and delinquency trends, are conditions better or worse than expected when guidance was established? Could these factors affect fu...
analyst_questions.response_summary: Well, objectively speaking, the conditions from the past to now are worse than the beginning of the year. Objectively speaking, before we talk about the portfolio itself, macroeconomics are worse, specifically because of the geopolitical events.

red_flags.quote: When we look at delinquency, you may recall that the first quarter is always more pressured.
Therefore, calendar effects were one of the main headwinds to margin this quarter.
This was a quarter marked by significant volatility, with many developments in both the local and global environments as you have been following.
The most important message is that in Brazil, we delivered a solid performance this quarter despite all the challenges.
The capital index hedge cost remains a headwind as it has historically due to interest rate differentials.

surprise_score.justification: Baseline surprise estimate based on: record/all-time-best metrics mentioned; management disclosed data it normally withholds; explicit acknowledgement that conditions worsened; guidance reaffirmed despite a tougher macro backdrop.
